多选：顶部动作条能批量完成 / 挪天 / 删；Enter 拿起整组，方向键只改预: Multi-select: the top action bar can complete / move / delete in bulk; Enter picks up the whole group, arrow keys only change the preview, and Enter again drops it.
总览是一周的复盘：马赛克看状态、点往期的周可以回看；「对比」也在这儿。: Review is the weekly review: the mosaic shows states, clicking an earlier week takes you back, and “Compare” lives here too.
临时安排块不登记在 Backlog；双击它的名字可以改。: Temp blocks aren't listed in Backlog; double-click the name to edit it.
· 在通知上点 ✓/✗，或回到应用窗口标记: · Mark ✓/✗ on the notification, or back in the app window
· 有空记一下: · Note it down when you can
{skipped} 块已标记，不跟着动: {skipped} blocks are marked and won't move
这块在漂流链上，所以不自动融合（合了就把漂流的来历吃掉了）: This block is on a drift chain, so it isn't auto-merged (merging would swallow the drift's history)
这块在序列里，所以不自动融合（序列里的位置不能动）: This block is in a sequence, so it isn't auto-merged (its position in the sequence can't move)
两块拼起来会超过 3 天上限 —— 所以没融合: Joining the two would exceed the 3-day limit — so they weren't merged
后面的 {cascaded} 块跟着挪了（含 {history_moved} 块: Shifted the {cascaded} blocks that follow (including {history_moved} marked ones)
后面的 {cascaded} 块跟着挪了（它们原本排在这个时段之前）: Shifted the {cascaded} blocks that follow (they were scheduled before this slot)
选中的块都已经标记过了: The selected blocks are already marked
选中的块不在这一周: The selected blocks aren't in this week
{marked} 块已标记，不跟着搬: {marked} blocks are marked and won't move with the rest
选中的块不在这一周，先翻到它们那一周: The selected blocks aren't in this week — jump to their week first
{missing} 块不在这一周，没跟上: {missing} blocks aren't in this week and didn't follow
已接在它后面（后面的 {cascaded} 块跟着挪了，含 {history_m: Linked after it (shifted the {cascaded} blocks that follow, including {history_moved} marked ones)
已接在它后面（后面的 {cascaded} 块跟着挪了）: Linked after it (shifted the {cascaded} blocks that follow)
这个块不在任何序列里: This block isn't in any sequence
已铺 {created} 块到这一周（Ctrl+Z 可撤销）: Applied {created} blocks to this week (Ctrl+Z to undo)
不再把相接/重叠的同一任务的块合成一块（含启动时的整理）；已经合过的块保持原样: No longer merges touching/overlapping blocks of the same task (including the cleanup at startup); already merged blocks stay as they are
块边缘的把手不出现、拖不动；鼠标拖动移动与键盘仍可用: Handles on block edges don't appear and can't be dragged; mouse dragging and the keyboard still work
双击时间轴空白格不再建块；已有的临时块照常显示: Double-clicking an empty timeline cell no longer creates a block; existing temp blocks still show
时间轴不再画「未完成」的灰色残影；总览里的痕迹仍在: The timeline no longer draws grey “not done” remnants; the traces in Review remain
不再弹漂流卡；之前漂出来的子块会从时间轴隐藏（不删数据），再打开原样回来: No more drift cards; child blocks drifted earlier are hidden from the timeline (data isn't deleted) and come back when re-enabled
块上的 ⛓ 与细线不出现、接链不可用；已有链接的数据保留: The ⛓ and thin lines on blocks don't appear and linking is unavailable; existing links are kept
只允许单选；Ctrl/Shift/框选/Ctrl+A 不生效、顶部动作条不出现: Only single selection; Ctrl/Shift/drag-select/Ctrl+A stop working and the top action bar doesn't appear
块上的键盘操作与键位栏不生效；Esc 与 Ctrl+Z 仍可用（顶部也有撤销按钮: Keyboard actions on blocks and the shortcut bar are disabled; Esc and Ctrl+Z still work (Undo is also in the top bar)
时间轴的「模板」入口不出现、模板建议不触发；已存的模板保留: The “Templates” entry point on the timeline doesn't appear and suggestions don't fire; saved templates are kept
顶部那条「要不要把上周存成模板？」不再出现（模板仍可手动存/铺）: The “Save last week as a template?” prompt at the top no longer appears (you can still save/apply templates manually)
不再自动排入重复块（Backlog 的重复表单也收起来）；已存的规则与已排的块保: Repeat blocks are no longer placed automatically (the repeat form in Backlog is hidden too); saved rules and placed blocks are kept
「总览」入口与复盘提醒都不出现；总览的数据仍在: The “Review” entry point and review reminders don't appear; the review data is still there
「统计」入口不出现（累计数据仍在记）: The “Stats” entry point doesn't appear (cumulative data is still recorded)
首次用到某功能时的那条一次性提示不再出现（不记「已看过」）: The one-off hint shown the first time you use a feature no longer appears (nothing is marked as seen)
托盘图标不再变色/闪烁/加红环；通知与菜单不受影响: The tray icon no longer changes color/blinks/gets a red ring; notifications and the menu are unaffected
托盘悬停与窗口标题回到默认文案: Tray tooltip and window title return to their default text
不再注册全局快捷键（组合键交还给系统 / 别的程序）；窗口照常用，只是别的程序里: The global hotkey is no longer registered (the combo goes back to the system / other apps); the window works as usual, but pressing the combo elsewhere won't summon it
取消选中 / 关面板 / 放弃线头（键盘版「点一下别处」）: Deselect / close panel / drop the link (the keyboard version of “click elsewhere”)
搬移：预览跟住鼠标，左键放下: Move: the preview follows the mouse, left click drops it
复制：预览跟住鼠标，左键放下（原块留着）: Copy: the preview follows the mouse, left click drops it (the original stays)
搬移 / 复制整组（跟鼠标，左键放下）: Move / copy the whole group (follows the mouse, left click drops)
拿起整组（再按放下）: Pick up the whole group (press again to drop)
快速加任务：展开 Backlog + 光标进「添加任务…」: Add a task fast: expand Backlog and put the cursor in “Add a task…”
打开主窗口（被占用时依次退到 Ctrl+Alt+W / Ctrl+Alt+Shi: Open the main window (if taken, it falls back to Ctrl+Alt+W / Ctrl+Alt+Shift+W in turn; the one in effect is shown in Settings → Features)
Ctrl+滚轮：在分隔条上{pane}，在时间轴上{slot}；其它位置保持浏览: Ctrl+wheel: {pane} on the divider, {slot} on the timeline; elsewhere the browser keeps its zoom.
